messages:
noah: Heads up — console shows p99 for /v2/embeddings in us-west jumping ~2.5x starting 10:05 UTC. p50/p95 stable. Anyone tracking this slice?

rachael: I see it. The region breakdown chart shows the spike specific to tenant=partner_alpha and route_variant=quantized.

mike: Could be quantization fallback on some requests (model switches mid-request) which would only affect a tiny fraction and blow out p99. Any sampling that shows model_variant per-sample?

rachael: quick query I ran: ```sql
SELECT model_variant, tenant, percentile(latency_ms,50) p50, percentile(latency_ms,95) p95, percentile(latency_ms,99) p99, count(*)
FROM telemetry_latency
WHERE route='/v2/embeddings' AND region='us-west' AND time>now()-interval '60 minutes'
GROUP BY model_variant, tenant
ORDER BY p99 DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

mike: results show model_variant=quantized-v1, tenant=partner_alpha -> p99=1800ms, p95=140ms; model_variant=fallback-cpu -> p99=1750ms but p95 ~200ms. There are also a handful of samples with sample_origin=reroute-proxy.

dashboard-bot: Canary deploy: routing policy change "quantized-fallback-retries" enabled for 20% traffic at 2026-03-18T09:58Z. Telemetry window active.

noah: reroute-proxy + fallback-cpu smell like retries losing KV cache and being routed to cpu fallback. If those are rare, they only show up at p99.

maria: two operational options: (A) annotate the dashboard with the feature-flag toggle time and add a small "slice by model_variant" dropdown; (B) adjust the default p99 to be a blended view that excludes sample_origins with low counts. Both have tradeoffs.

rachael: prefer (A). Blending hides real tail events from tenants who care. We should make it easy to split by sample_origin/model_variant and show sample counts.

mike: agree. short-term: add dashboard annotation and a tooltip listing recent routing policy toggles. Also add a tiny sample-count badge next to p99. longer-term: add automatic alerts when p99 diverges from p95 by >5x for a slice with count>10.

noah: I'll file follow-up RT-4422 for UI changes + alert rule. For immediate mitigation, can we disable quantized-fallback-retries for partner_alpha in the canary?

maria: I can flip that flag for the canary cohort in 2m. will post once done.

dashboard-bot: Feature-flag change: quantized-fallback-retries -> OFF for canary cohort at 10:12 UTC per request by maria.

rachael: requerying panels now, p99 for partner_alpha down to baseline. leaving the annotation and ticket so we remember to add split-by controls.

mike: also adding a note in the runbook: "When enabling routing fallbacks, expect p99 sensitivity; always surface sample counts and model_variant in rollups."

noah: thanks everyone. we'll keep the ticket and schedule a quick UX spike to prototype the badge + dropdown. :raised_hands:
